details: For finite concept classes; projected recursive teaching dimension is a lower bound for order compression (Theorem 4).
name: Order Sample Compression / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: For every coordinate set, Theorem 1 restricts an order scheme to that projection without increasing its size.  The maximal teaching-plan argument of Lemma 1 lower-bounds the resulting order-scheme size by the recursive teaching dimension of that projection.  Taking the maximum over projections is Theorem 4.
